scientific_question: Along one synchronized dense path and one shared task gradient, is the remaining Pair-VQ self-training error caused primarily by compact code-conditioned Muon momentum and its nonlinear polar map, or by the final compact retraction?

causal_basis.finding: Endpoint capacity and teacher-forced forward gradients pass, but self-training remains at the same compact floor. The untested map is the accumulated compact momentum followed by Muon's nonlinear polar transform.

theory.dense_transition: For gradient G_t and dense momentum B_t, compute B_(t+1)=mu*B_t+G_t and U_dense=MuonPolar(G_t+mu*B_(t+1)).
theory.compact_transition: Using the same G_t and current teacher-forced Pair-VQ codes, aggregate gradient pairs by code, update only the production compact code-conditioned momentum, expand it through those codes, and compute U_compact=MuonPolar(G_t+mu*ExpandedMomentum_(t+1)).
theory.polar_nonlinearity: High cosine before Muon is not sufficient because Newton-Schulz polar normalization can amplify singular-subspace differences. Metrics therefore cover both combined pre-polar tensors and final scaled polar updates.
theory.retraction_control: Project both dense-state and compact-state virtual requests through an isolated clone of the production Pair-VQ plus B64/L16 feedback transition. This separates optimizer-field error from the already small but late-degrading retraction error.
theory.shared_path: The dense parent path is never modified by any candidate. Dense gradients drive both momentum trackers so gradient-path differences cannot contaminate the primary momentum attribution.
theory.deployability_scope: Dense momentum is an oracle reference only and is never candidate state. Passing this localization does not authorize retaining dense momentum.

frozen_protocol.parent: exact 124M QK-only BlockFHT attention plus dense MLP parent, seed 1337, LR 0.0024, 238 updates
frozen_protocol.compact_family: production full-MLP Pair-VQ with forward-visible fractional_lattice_q7q8_b32_p25_rq4_cfcq5b64l16 feedback
frozen_protocol.gradient_source: the exact dense-parent training gradient before its Muon update
momentum_trackers: the parent's actual dense Muon momentum
a nonintervening production compact code-conditioned momentum tracker updated from the identical dense gradient and current teacher-forced codes
comparisons: dense combined momentum tensor versus expanded compact combined momentum tensor
dense scaled polar update versus compact-state scaled polar update
dense-state virtual request versus compact-state virtual request
each request before versus after the identical production Pair-VQ plus feedback retraction

per_matrix: relative error, cosine, and positive-line energy recovery before polar
relative error, cosine, and positive-line energy recovery after polar
requested-step energy recovery and cosine after retraction
aggregate: energy-weighted metrics for all matrices, c_fc, and c_proj
fraction of total dense-request error attributable to compact momentum/polar versus retraction

classification_gate.momentum_polar_primary_if: At both late probes, compact-state polar error exceeds the isolated retraction error and accounts for at least 70 percent of total compact-request squared error.
classification_gate.retraction_primary_if: At both late probes, production retraction accounts for at least 70 percent of total compact-request squared error.
classification_gate.mixed_or_unresolved_if: Neither source reaches the frozen 70 percent attribution threshold at both late probes.

decision_rule.momentum_polar_primary: Authorize theory work on a compact momentum representation or polar computation that preserves the dense update field; do not authorize an LM endpoint from this oracle alone.
decision_rule.retraction_primary: Return to compact transition geometry only; do not change LR, bits, width, FHT, horizon, or model size without a new theory.
decision_rule.mixed_or_unresolved: Stop Pair-VQ endpoint trials and derive a new joint-state model before any new training run.

execution_gate.watchdog_callbacks: terminal/error-only because the replay is expected within one to two hours
